title: MantaHealth private-deploy quick notes & action list
content:
Context: quick, messy scratchpad for MantaHealth private deployment kickoff. Goal is to capture my day-to-day action items, commands to re-run, and configuration gotchas we hit in the PoC. Not a final runbook — will clean up after go/no-go.

Top-level constraints and notes:
- Customer requires VPC-only access, no egress to public internet from inference nodes.
- KMS-backed model keys for audit (FIPS-compatible HSM to be evaluated later).
- SLA ask: 99.9% monthly, burst to handle nightly batch scoring.
- Target latency p50 < 45ms for 2k tokens, baseline tests on g5.2x.

Immediate checklist (today):
[ ] Confirm VPC peering settings with Manta network (contact: mnet@mantahealth.com).
[ ] Validate KMS alias creation and policy with customer's security team.
[ ] Push initial private control-plane jumpbox image to customer's registry.
[ ] Run smoke sequence on a pinned model (redwood-moderato-3b-quant) via local shim.

Troubles/observations during PoC runs:
- Observed unexpected DNS timeouts when NAT gateway was disabled. It turns out our build step pulls container metadata from public registries; need an off-registry mirror for private mode.
- KV cache warm-up: first cold request per node was ~150ms slower; consider enabling prefix cache warmers at startup.
- Quantization mismatch: customer's inference VM had CUDA 12.1 but we compiled kernels for 12.0 -> trace: kernel init warnings in /var/log/redwood/serve.log. Action: build second artifact for 12.1.

Quick commands to re-run locally (notes for myself):
- build artifact for cuda12.1:
  ./scripts/build-artifact.sh --cuda 12.1 --tag manta-12.1-test

- start local dev shim to emulate private control plane (uses .env.local):
  REDWOOD_MODE=private ./bin/control-plane-shim --config .manta/config.yml

- smoke test (single-token):
  curl -sS -X POST https://localhost:8443/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer LOCAL' -d '{"model":"manta-test","input":"hello"}' | jq '.'

Environment variables we used for PoC (for copying into customer's env):
- REDWOOD_CONTROL_PLANE_URL=https://cp.manta.internal
- REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS=projects/manta/locations/global/keyRings/rw-keys/cryptoKeys/model-enc
- REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info
- REDWOOD_METRICS_EXPORTER=prometheus:9091

Network checklist (for infra/ops handoff):
- Required: VPC peering to control plane subnets (10.20.0.0/16 -> 10.200.0.0/16)
- Required: Private ECR mirror or approved images in customer's registry
- Optional: AWS PrivateLink for metrics/ops endpoint (ask security if allowed)

KMS & key handling notes:
- Customer wants HSM-backed keys; recommended flow: key envelope encryption on-client + KMS Unwrap on dedicated infra.
- Make sure key rotation window is >= 30d for ML checkpoint compatibility (we had one rotation spike where tokens failed).

Rollout plan (quick sketch):
1) PoC stabilization: finalize build artifacts for target CUDA, ensure container mirror available, resolve DNS/build pull issue. (owner: Ava)
2) Security review & KMS policy sign-off (owner: Priya)
3) Small-scale internal canary: 2 nodes, limited traffic, synthetic prompt set to validate latency/cost (owner: Diego)
4) Customer canary: route 5% traffic for 48h, monitor quality regressions and latency SLO (owner: Manta SRE)

Open questions / TODOs to follow up:
- Does Manta want model weights encrypted at rest in an extra layer beyond KMS envelope? (Ask security)
- Confirm the approved container registries and whether images can be ephemeral.
- Get list of sequences (approx token lengths per request) so we can tune batching window.

Notes to self / reminders:
- When writing the clean runbook, include sample IAM role JSON and minimal SG rules (customer asked for minimal exposure).
- Capture the prefix cache warm-up script and include in startup hooks.
- Add an automated check that fails preflight if control-plane cannot reach KMS endpoint over private link.

End-of-day summary (quick):
- Built 12.1 artifact locally, pushed tag to my dev registry.
- Network team confirmed peering prerequisites but waiting on hostname mapping from Manta DNS owner.
- Next step: schedule 30m alignment call with Manta Sec + Manta SRE (propose Tue 2026-03-16 09:00 PT).

Anything in here can be messy — will extract tasks into JIRA and clean up after the alignment call.

-- Ava
